body:
### Describe the solution you'd like

When the tracing interceptor is in use, by default creating a schedule should create a span for the schedule and set it on the workflow header if the action is starting a workflow. Users need to be able to opt-out in their tracing interceptor options.

comments.body: (do not blindly implement as is, see discussion starting with comment https://github.com/temporalio/features/issues/394#issuecomment-1966551344 before proceeding)

@cretz  Know of any workarounds for this in the Python SDK? With the `always_create_workflow_spans` #794  parameter do get spans created when kicked off from a schedule, but without a common parent span so they are all not associated with each other.

There is not currently a workaround since scheduled workflows are created server side and spans are created client side. Even if you create your own span (like we do) when workflow starts client-side, that span will not remain the parent if the workflow runs on another worker.

Hi @cretz 👋 it's been a while since this issue was opened. I was curious if there are any recommended solutions for this problem?

We are using several schedules in our application and this issue is preventing us from having the level of tracing that we would like and that we are used to from other types of workflow executions.

@cdimitroulas take a look at the new plugin approach at https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/tree/main/temporalio/contrib/opentelemetry. This allows spans with durations to exist inside of workflows, so I think it should solve your use case.

Thank you @tconley1428, though it doesn't look appropriate for my use-case. Firstly, it is in an experimental state which I am not comfortable depending on in production and secondly, it doesn't seem to work with `ddtrace-run` which means that we would need to manually instrument the things which ddtrace currently auto-instruments or use an alternative like `opentelemetry-instrument` which I'm not that keen to spend time on since we use datadog in all our apps (and would rather use their own existing tools).

title: [Feature Request] Schedule creation should create tracing span by default
